title: Size at the typical threshold cutoff
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $t_n=\left\lfloor\frac n2+\frac n2\sqrt{\frac{2\log(48n)}{n}}\right\rfloor$. The number of subsets of an $n$-element set having size at most $t_n$ is at least $\left(1-\frac{(1/2)^2}{6n}\right)2^n$.
